definitions: A type of insurance that pays out a pre-agreed amount if a specific, measurable parameter (e.g., wind speed, rainfall) is met or exceeded, rather than based on actual losses.
Insurance coverage that triggers payouts based on the occurrence of a defined event or the intensity of a pre-determined index, without requiring a loss adjustment process.
examples: Farmers used parametric insurance against drought.
The payout from parametric insurance was swift.
